home.title: MakeKeeper on your phone
home.subtitle: Stock the inventory where the parts actually are.
home.noSurfaces: No plugin offers a mobile screen right now.

install.title: Install on this phone
install.offer: Installing puts MakeKeeper on the home screen: it opens full-screen like an app, and this phone keeps its own sign-in. Install first, then pair the installed app — it has its own storage.
install.manual: This browser has no install button of its own. Open its menu — on iPhone that is the Share button — and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.accepted: MakeKeeper was added to your home screen
install.ephemeralHost: This address is a temporary tunnel and its name changes on every restart. The icon will keep working only until then, and everything this phone stored goes with it.
install.insecure: Installation needs a secure (https) address. Over plain http the browser also blocks the camera.

pair.title: Pair this phone
pair.subtitle: One scan, and this phone stays signed in.
pair.failed: Pairing failed. The code may have expired or already been used.
pair.scanHint: Scan the pairing QR from the desktop app: open MakeKeeper on the computer and press the QR button in the header.
pair.cameraFailed: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access for this app, or sign in with your password instead.
pair.passwordInstead: Sign in with a password instead

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: This phone lost its pairing. Sign in to get it back.
login.scanInstead: Pair by scanning a QR instead
login.deviceTokenFailed: Signed in, but this phone could not be remembered — it may ask again later. Scan the pairing QR to fix that.

origin.summary: Whether the address this request arrived at can host an installed mobile app, whether a phone can be paired at all, and where the surface is published

settings.summary: Mobile app settings: where the surface is published
settings.customOriginDescription: Absolute origin the mobile surface is published at. Empty clears it and the surface lives at /m on the main address.

errors.invalidOrigin: Enter an absolute address, for example https://phone.example.com
errors.noPhoneAddress: There is no address a phone could reach this instance at

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.subtitle: Phones signed in to this instance with their own long-lived credential.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? It stops working immediately and has to be paired again.
devices.separateOriginNote: The mobile surface is published on its own host, so the session cookie is issued for the domain configured in SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN and travels to every host under it. Keep that domain as narrow as the two addresses allow.
devices.pairingStatusSummary: Whether a pairing offer has been taken up yet, so the desktop can close its QR
devices.pairSelfSummary: Issue a device token to the phone that is already signed in

errors.pairingRejected: This pairing code is not valid. It may have expired or already been used.
errors.selfPairFailed: Could not remember this device. Please try again.

origin.label: Address of the mobile app
origin.help: Leave empty to serve it at /m on the main address. A separate host installs as its own app and needs SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN set.
origin.envOverride: Set by MOBILE_BASE_URL in the environment, which wins over this field. Clear the variable to manage the address here.

cookieDomain.label: Session cookie domain
cookieDomain.help: Read-only: SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN has to be known before the first request is served, so it stays an environment variable.

pairQr.title: Open the app on your phone
pairQr.description: Scan with the phone camera. This both opens the app and connects the phone — the code works once, for the next few minutes.
pairQr.linkHint: Can't scan it? Open this link on the phone.
pairQr.alt: QR code opening the mobile app
pairQr.aria: Open the app on a phone
pairQr.label: Open on the phone
pairQr.warmupNote: A tunnel that has just started is not reachable for a few seconds. The code appears once it is.
pairQr.expired: The code expired — press the button again

orientation.title: Turn the phone upright
orientation.body: This screen is built for portrait. On its side the camera controls fall below the fold and the tab bar covers the page.

mobile.name: Mobile app
mobile.description: The phone-sized surface: stocking the inventory where the parts are, paired devices, and where it is published.
